title: Week of Nov 2
text: Written Oct 26 from LinkedIn and Instagram posts published Oct 12–25 (Supermetrics): 33 LinkedIn posts, the last on Oct 23, and 20 Instagram posts. Compared with Sep 14 to Oct 11 and with September. Last week's two experiments start this week, so none of their results are in yet.

title: On LinkedIn, brand-side guests drew nearly five times the impressions of other guests.
text: Of the 12 guest interviews posted Oct 12–23, the 5 with brand, health or retail marketers (PepsiCo, Organon, Marriott, Clue) drew a median 1,865 impressions and 37 comments in all. The 7 with media, ad tech, agency or trade-body guests drew a median 388 and 13 comments. September ran the same way, with a smaller gap: 785 for 8 brand-side guests against 534 for 19 others. The one brand-side miss was a second, off-duty cut: Elizabeth Latham (Marriott) on Philadelphia football drew 234, against 1,865 for her Marriott Media interview. On Instagram the edge does not hold: brand-side guest reels had a median reach of 201, against 241 for the rest.

title: Instagram reach came from event reels, and none has run since Oct 9.
text: The four event reels of Oct 6–9 (Kargo Karnival, the Stagwell Media launch, Advertising Week, the MS NOW fan event) reached a median 765 accounts. The 13 guest reels of Oct 12–25 reached a median 210, and no post has passed 500 since Oct 15. The one event since, the datafuelX launch on Oct 19, was captioned around the guest's numbers, not the scene, and reached 144. Honoree reels gave the only other lift (Michelle Crossan-Matos 1,615, Sara Fischer 876), though Diana Haussling's reached 101. Instagram's 28-day reach is 28,087, down 35% on the 28 days to Sep 24 and still falling (29,981 to Oct 22).

title: LinkedIn bunched its posts early in the week, and Thursday and Friday sagged.
text: Oct 19–21 carried 12 of the week's 14 LinkedIn posts and 5 of its 6 guest interviews; Oct 22–23 had one interview (Todd Porch, Strategus) and one vote reminder. Those two days drew 2,790 impressions, 42% below the same days a week earlier (4,816), which carried 9 posts with three interviews and an honoree. Monday to Wednesday rose to 7,712 impressions from 5,873, and Thursday and Friday gave it back: the weekdays of Oct 19–23 drew 10,502 from 14 posts, against 10,689 from 19 the week before. Fewer posts cost little; an empty end of the week cost more. A Friday interview is no sure thing, though: Rajeev Goel (PubMatic) on Oct 16 drew 179.

title: Run one guest interview each weekday, with brand-side guests on Thursday and Friday.
text: From Nov 2 to Nov 6 on LinkedIn, post one guest interview a day in the main slot, at the same hour, instead of two or three early in the week. Give Thursday Nov 5 and Friday Nov 6 to brand, health or retail marketers from the bank. Keep any second post that day to a newsroom, recap or Movers post.
next_step: Measure: Nov 5–6 impressions against 2,790 (Oct 22–23), and the two brand-side interviews' impressions after seven days against 388, the median for other guests Oct 12–23.

title: Post two event reels on Instagram that open on the scene, as collabs with the host.
text: Cut two reels from events ATM has filmed and not yet posted on Instagram, or from the next event it films. Open on the scene (the room, the stunt, the crowd) and start the caption with what people saw, as the Advertising Week reel did. Invite the host brand's account as collaborator, and post the two on different days.
next_step: Measure: reach per reel after seven days against 210, the median guest reel Oct 12–25 (765, the Oct 6–9 event reels, is the stretch), and Instagram 28-day reach against 28,087 (to Oct 25).
